0022600165.text: The 1-4 Pelicans, who are 0-2 on the road and 12th in the West, visit the 5-0 Grizzlies, who lead the Southwest and the West and have won five straight. New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Memphis is missing Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Ty Jerome (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Pelicans winning the last meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
